references.text: Balak took Balaam to a high place to see the people of Israel, which is repeated here as Balak tries a new location.
Balak suggests another new place in hopes that Balaam will curse Israel from there, the same strategy as in verse 13.
Continuation of Balak's attempts to find a suitable place to curse Israel.
The first location where Balak asked Balaam to curse Israel, before he tried a new spot.
Balak's original desire for Balaam to curse the people he sees, reflected in his repeated efforts.
